An update is available for mysql8.4.
This update affects Rocky Linux 10.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
MySQL is a multi-user, multi-threaded SQL database server. MySQL is a client/server implementation consisting of a server daemon (mysqld) and many different client programs and libraries. The base package contains the standard MySQL client programs and generic MySQL files.

Security Fix(es):

* mysql: Performance Schema unspecified vulnerability (CPU Jul 2026) (CVE-2026-61081)

* mysql: Optimizer unspecified vulnerability (CPU Jul 2026) (CVE-2026-47064)
